title: Concept: Script is loaded from another origin without an integrity hash
description: A cross-origin script without an integrity hash means the page executes whatever that host returns at that moment. Compromising the third party, its CDN or a response in transit then yields script execution in this origin, with access to the session and the DOM.
applicability: Responses that load JavaScript from a third-party origin.
risk: An attacker who controls or can modify the third-party response executes arbitrary script in the application origin.
